Model card: Ming-3.0-audio-tiny Hear clearly. Understand deeply. Act intelligently. Ming-3.0-audio-tiny is a compact native audio-language model from inclusionAI. It accepts audio together with text instructions and supports speech recognition, spoken question answering, audio understanding, audio reasoning, and optional synthesized-speech responses. GitHub · 🤖 ModelScope · 🤗 Flash · 🤗 Tiny · 💻 Examples Model Summary | Property | Description | | --- | --- | | Developer | inclusionAI | | Model type | Compact native audio-language Mixture-of-Experts model | | Parameters | 9.3B total parameters, 2.7B activated per inference step | | Inputs | Audio and text instructions | | Outputs | Text, or text with optional synthesized speech | | Primary languages | Chinese and English, including varied accents and dialects | | License | MIT | Highlights - **Efficient audio intelligence:** Provides speech and audio understanding in a compact Mixture-of-Experts model. - **Complex speech recognition:** Handles Chinese and English speech, dialects, accents, noisy environments, and multi-speaker recordings. - **Long-audio understanding:** Comprehends and analyzes long-form recordings. - **Multidimensional perception:** Understands speech, non-speech sounds, acoustic scenes, and music. - **Audio reasoning:** Answers questions and performs reasoning over audio content. - **Audio interaction:** Produces text responses and can optionally synthesize speech with built-in voices or a reference voice.
